# START-HERE

<!-- generated by scripts/docs/generate_solo_agent_docs.py; edit source data in srl.labctl -->
Scientific Reasoning Fabric starts from one JSON-first entrypoint:

```bash
srlab labctl enter
```

A successful entry emits `LabCtlEnterReport/v1` with a scope-only
`LabAccessReceipt/v1`. The receipt never grants authority, never
permits live trading, and never permits target-specific security action.

Minimum fresh-agent sequence:

1. Run `srlab labctl enter`.
2. Run `srlab doctor`.
3. Inspect available capabilities with `srlab catalog inspect`.
4. Build a request with `srlab plan build <bundle-file>`.
5. Execute only bounded, admitted work with `srlab run execute <run-spec-file>`.
